scripts.dev:server: sh -c 'export $(grep -v "^#" .env | xargs) && cd server && mvn spring-boot:run'
scripts.dev:both: concurrently -n backend,mobile -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:mobile"
scripts.postinstall: concurrently -n mobile,server -c green,blue "npm --prefix mobile install" "cd server && mvn dependency:resolve -q"
